scope.trackedFiles: all Git blobs, no silent exclusions

acceptance_criteria.description: All pinned tracked files are accounted for with blob id, kind, area or explicit non-Rust classification, and evidence status
Every Rust file has a source-anchored explanation; excerpt coverage is separate from full-file review
Every Rust file has a full-file review recording public operations and branches; an excerpt is not sufficient
All 11 areas have an authored operation with plain role/input/output/boundary, source anchors, and contextual hints on the same page
Every published source hint matches the pinned blob, line and hash; no invalid evidence or unknown terms
Three personas complete all 11 fixed tasks within 8 clicks each with role/input/output/boundary supported by visible source, in-place hints and no blocker
All three personas retain URL, selected line and hint across assistance changes, and no saved or draft note is lost
Actual novice learners independently explain role/input/output/failure from source after closing help; AI roleplay does not satisfy this gate

tasks.goal: ノードの起動完了と終了待ちを区別する
送信要求の入口で、受け取るものと返すものを確かめる
プール追加の前に何を確かめ、何を返すかを読む
通信の処理が待っているときに何が起きるかを読む
過去のブロックをそろえる処理の進み方を読む
届いた要求をどう振り分けるかを読む
ブロック内の処理を実行する入口を読む
ブロック候補を作る処理と結果を読む
状態を保存する処理の入力と結果を読む
新しいブロックなどを外の機能へ伝える処理を読む
チェーンの設定を読み取る処理と失敗時の扱いを読む

evaluation.stopPolicy: Do not lower gates or replace unobserved tasks with passes. A round can finish with productComplete=false; retain unmet conditions.
